'''2017 US Nationals Jon McFarland DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jon McFarland]] at [[2017 U.S. National Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Jon McFarland]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 U.S. National Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration|SE-D-carbonchambertesting.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open CCT McFarland DS 2017 Nats.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/resources/tournament-decklists/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013125443/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/tournament-decklists.html Internet Archive]
